market_definition: The one-component epoxy adhesives market comprises premixed, single-package epoxy adhesives that cure on heat or latent catalyst activation without on-site mixing. It measures sales of finished adhesives used for structural, electronic and industrial bonding. BY RESIN BASE: Bisphenol-A Epoxy, Bisphenol-F Epoxy, Novolac Epoxy, Other Epoxy Resins. BY CURE MECHANISM: Heat-Cured, Latent Catalyst-Cured, Other Cure Systems. BY FORM: Paste, Liquid, Syringe & Cartridge Packs. BY END-USE INDUSTRY: Automotive & Transportation, Building & Construction, Electronics & Electrical, Packaging & Converting, Woodworking & Furniture, Industrial Assembly & Machinery, Other End-Use Industries. BY REGION: North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia Pacific (APAC), Middle East, Africa. EXCLUDED from the market: Two-component epoxy adhesives; epoxy adhesive films; UV-curable and dual-cure adhesives; epoxy resins sold as coatings or composite matrix material. COMPANY TYPE IN THIS LIST - DISTRIBUTOR: a distributor, stockist or specialty reseller that buys these products from their makers and sells them to industrial, construction or trade customers. EXCLUDED companies: product and raw-material makers and their own sales subsidiaries; companies selling only the excluded products; service-only firms. GEOGRAPHY OF THIS LIST: EUROPE - companies headquartered in a European country (EU, United Kingdom, EFTA, Western Balkans, Ukraine, Moldova, Russia).
who_is_included: DISTRIBUTOR DEFINITION (physical goods market): a company whose PRIMARY business is buying in volume from manufacturers and reselling/distributing onward - wholesale, authorized, value-added or stocking distributor. EXCLUDED: channel partners, resellers, VARs, dealers, agents and brokers that do not stock or wholesale; manufacturers and OEMs (including a manufacturer's own sales subsidiary); system integrators; and pure service providers or consultancies. Continent / Geography = countries with a physical site (HQ, office, warehouse, plant). Operational Presence = every country the company does business in, which is WIDER.
